en.title: A 380,000-parameter Transformer squeezed onto a floppy disk: a 30-year-old 486 can now "run AI

en.title: AI and a human each submit a Millennium Prize answer: one writes a 79-page proof with Claude, the other pulls out a 940-page handwritten draft 12 years in the making
en.reason: Levent Alpöge and an NYU professor used Claude for a 79-page Navier–Stokes finite-time blowup proof still unverified because its key numerical certificate is unpublished, while Alessandro Maria Masullo spent 12 years and 940 AI-free pages on the generalized Riemann hypothesis.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: MiniMax 用内部模型自动做密码分析，首次真正攻破多个 NIST 竞赛候选算法，把纸面攻击推进到秒级或分钟级，并在近期顶会方案上实现密文伪造、密钥恢复和破译轮数新纪录。

en.title: MiniMax turns its in-house model loose on cryptography, turning paper attacks into real-world exploits in seconds and achieving the first genuine break of a NIST competition algorithm
en.reason: MiniMax's internal model automated cryptanalysis and became the first to truly break multiple NIST competition candidate algorithms, cutting paper attacks to seconds or minutes and setting records in ciphertext forgery, key recovery and broken rounds on recent top-conference schemes.

en.title:
The weekend’s biggest news wasn’t a US stock market crash—it was AI claiming to prove the Riemann Hypothesis

This weekend, what truly shook the world was not the sharp selloff in US stocks but news from the math world: on November 20, Levent Alpöge, a 34-year-old mathematician at Anthropic, posted a statement on his personal website saying he had worked with the company’s large model Claude to find a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, which has puzzled mathematicians for 167 years, and that the method could be extended to the stronger Generalized Riemann Hypothesis.
en.reason: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge's November 20 announcement that he and Claude found a proof of the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis, and say the method extends to the generalized Riemann hypothesis, landed the day after Anthropic's Nasdaq IPO, a timing he called "terrible.

Anthropic 面临着两套检验、资金从 AI 相关股票中撤出。
本文字数：7889 字
阅读完需：约 26 分钟
Anthropic 于当地时间 2026 年 11 月 19 日正式在纳斯达克挂牌上市。其发行价为 83 美元，实际开盘价为 111.50 美元，较发行价高约 34.3%。
“还没开始交易，暗盘的人已经先赚走两成了。”有网友感慨道。但在开盘后，股价一度快速冲高，随后有所回落。盘中最高触及 115.1 美元，最低一度跌破开盘价，来到 95.05 美元。
上市后的一段时间里，纳指、道指、标普 500 指数都出现了不同幅度的下跌，知名科技公司股价也反复震荡。
上市带来的乐观情绪并未持续。11 月 20 日，Anthropic 股价在第二个交易日下跌约 9%，盘中一度跌至 85 美元附近，接近 83 美元的发行价。此前在二级市场追高买入的散户投资者开始面临亏损。根据 Vanda Research 的数据，上市首日散户投资者交易的 Anthropic 股票金额超过 7.5 亿美元，创下该机构追踪的 IPO 首日散

en.title: Anthropic's record IPO fails to lift AI market gloom as Claude suffers a sudden performance outage on listing day — it's time to pump the brakes on a trillion-dollar valuation propped up by job-loss anxiety
en.summary:
Anthropic faces twin tests as capital retreats from AI-related stocks.
Anthropic faces twin tests as capital retreats from AI-related stocks.
Length: 7,889 characters. Reading time: about 26 minutes.
Anthropic officially listed on Nasdaq on Nov. 19, 2026, local time. Its IPO price was $83, and its actual opening price was $111.50, about 34.3% above the IPO price.
Before trading even began, grey-market investors had already pocketed a 20% gain, one online commenter remarked. But after the open, the stock initially surged, then pulled back. It hit an intraday high of $115.1 and at one point fell below the opening price to $95.05.
In the period after the listing, the Nasdaq, Dow and S&P 500 all fell by varying degrees, and shares of well-known tech companies swung repeatedly.
The optimism around the listing did not last. On Nov. 20, Anthropic shares fell about 9% on the second trading day, at one point dropping to around $85, close to the $83 IPO price. Retail investors who had chased the stock higher in the secondary market began to face losses.
According to Vanda Research data, retail investors traded more than $750 million worth of Anthropic stock on the first day of listing, setting a record for first-day retail trading in an IPO tracked by the firm.
en.reason: Anthropic listed on Nasdaq at $83 per share and opened at $111.50, with retail trading exceeding $750 million on day one before the stock fell about 9% on day two, while the article dissects how the company converts white-collar job-replacement anxiety into revenue and valuation.

sources.title_original: 具身智能进入大浪淘沙阶段，企业需要怎样的人才？
sources.summary:
在潮水退去后仍然保留下来的知识、经验和能力，也许会在下一轮浪潮中，获得意想不到的回报。
在潮水退去后仍然保留下来的知识、经验和能力，也许会在下一轮浪潮中，获得意想不到的回报。
本文字数：5079 字
阅读完需：约 17 分钟
2025 年至 2026 年上半年，具身智能经历了一轮融资狂热。根据 IT 桔子数据，2025 年全年融资超过 300 起、约 379 亿元，而 2026 年仅上半年就发生 322 起融资、总额达到 935 亿元。但进入下半年，投资机构开始放慢出手节奏，越来越重视技术差异化和商业化前景。
行业正在进入大浪淘沙的阶段。
过去三年，具身智能吸引了大量来自自动驾驶、大模型、计算机视觉等领域的人才。顶尖研究者成为大厂争夺的对象，甚至有尚未毕业的博士生被投资人说服创业。如今，随着融资环境与商业化要求发生变化，创业公司的招聘标准也在调整。这让已经进入行业，以及准备入行的人面临新的问题：哪些技术人才依然稀缺？这个行业还有多少机会？
最近，InfoQ 与 Xbotics 联合举办了“具身智能人才地图”主题直播。我们与共生知行创始人兼 CEO 丁鹏翔、同舟问智创始人温兴男，以及松应
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 在2026年上半年具身智能发生322起、935亿元融资后投资放慢的背景下，InfoQ与Xbotics直播中丁鹏翔、温兴男、张小波讨论人才标准如何从VLA复现转向真机部署与完整项目经验。

en.title: As embodied AI enters a shakeout phase, what kind of talent do companies need?
en.summary:
The knowledge, experience, and capabilities that remain after the tide goes out may deliver unexpected returns in the next wave.

The knowledge, experience, and capabilities that remain after the tide goes out may deliver unexpected returns in the next wave.

Word count: 5,079
Reading time: about 17 minutes

From 2025 through the first half of 2026, embodied AI went through a funding frenzy. According to IT Juzi data, there were more than 300 funding deals in all of 2025, totaling about RMB 37.9 billion, while the first half of 2026 alone saw 322 deals totaling RMB 93.5 billion. But in the second half of the year, investment institutions began to slow their pace and increasingly prioritized technological differentiation and commercialization prospects.

The industry is entering a shakeout phase.

Over the past three years, embodied AI has attracted a large number of people from autonomous driving, large models, computer vision, and other fields. Top researchers became targets in big tech’s talent wars, and even PhD students who had not yet graduated were persuaded by investors to start companies. Now, as the funding environment and commercialization requirements change, startups’ hiring standards are also shifting. This leaves people already in the industry—and those preparing to enter it—facing new questions: Which technical talent is still scarce? How many opportunities remain in this industry?

Recently, InfoQ and Xbotics jointly hosted a livestream themed Embodied AI Talent Map. We were joined by Ding Pengxiang, founder and CEO of Gongsheng Zhixing; Wen Xingnan, founder of Tongzhou Wenzhi; and Songying.
en.reason: After 322 embodied-AI funding deals totaling 93.5 billion yuan in H1 2026, InfoQ and Xbotics' livestream with Ding Pengxiang, Wen Xingnan and Zhang Xiaobo examines hiring shifting from VLA replication to real-robot deployment and complete project experience.

en.title: As embodied AI enters a shakeout phase, what kind of talent do companies need?
en.summary:
The knowledge, experience, and capabilities that remain after the tide goes out may deliver unexpected returns in the next wave.

The knowledge, experience, and capabilities that remain after the tide goes out may deliver unexpected returns in the next wave.

Word count: 5,079
Reading time: about 17 minutes

From 2025 through the first half of 2026, embodied AI went through a funding frenzy. According to IT Juzi data, there were more than 300 funding deals in all of 2025, totaling about RMB 37.9 billion, while the first half of 2026 alone saw 322 deals totaling RMB 93.5 billion. But in the second half of the year, investment institutions began to slow their pace and increasingly prioritized technological differentiation and commercialization prospects.

The industry is entering a shakeout phase.

Over the past three years, embodied AI has attracted a large number of people from autonomous driving, large models, computer vision, and other fields. Top researchers became targets in big tech’s talent wars, and even PhD students who had not yet graduated were persuaded by investors to start companies. Now, as the funding environment and commercialization requirements change, startups’ hiring standards are also shifting. This leaves people already in the industry—and those preparing to enter it—facing new questions: Which technical talent is still scarce? How many opportunities remain in this industry?

Recently, InfoQ and Xbotics jointly hosted a livestream themed Embodied AI Talent Map. We were joined by Ding Pengxiang, founder and CEO of Gongsheng Zhixing; Wen Xingnan, founder of Tongzhou Wenzhi; and Songying.

stories.title: OpenAI 确实有可能在短期崩盘。 原因有不少，加起来能不能达到崩盘的阈值，看运气。 也许YES 也许NO。 第一点， 最致命的，是奥特曼不遵守财务纪律，去年10月，越过NVDA和谷歌这些芯片供应商，直接跑到韩国去要HBM，直接导致原已紧张的内存+存储价格，原地爆炸。据我分析，OpenAI由于GB200 机柜交付的延期，在去年确实面临了长期的算力短缺，痛定思痛是一方面的，但是另外不排除奥特曼的焦土战略，我买光市场上的芯片，自用出租两…

en.title: OpenAI really could collapse in the short term.
en.reason: OpenAI’s reported October push for HBM in South Korea, bypassing NVDA and Google, tightened already strained memory and storage prices amid GB200 rack delays, and this analysis weighs that scarcity and cash-flow pressure as short-term collapse risks.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Reddit用户ShweetsStuff发现《The Binding of Isaac: Repentance Plus》的GTA主题段落音频带有Suno元数据，Edmund McMillen称自己不知情并道歉，Nicalis随后移除相关AI音乐，但Steam上仍遭差评轰炸、评价为“overwhelmingly negative”。

en.reason: Reddit user ShweetsStuff found Suno metadata in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance Plus's GTA-themed segment, prompting Edmund McMillen to apologize as unaware and Nicalis to remove the AI music, though Steam reviews remain overwhelmingly negative.

stories.title: 最近刷了几家大模型的新动态，突然有个很强的感受：御三家（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google）现在几乎不怎么把“写代码”当核心卖点宣传了，反而全都在卷数学证明、生物科研、奥赛金牌这种硬核场景。 背后的逻辑其实挺现实的：Coding 已经卷到头了，日常开发够用，宣传上讲不出新故事了；大家必须去找难度更高、更能证明“智商上限”的考场，来撑住技术领先的叙事。 但挺魔幻的一点是，现实世界里 AI 连基础普及都还远没做到，绝大多数普通…

en.title: After scrolling through recent updates from several major model labs, one thing struck me: the big three (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) barely pitch "writing code" as a core selling point anymore. Instead, they're all competing over hardcore scenarios like mathematical proofs, biological research, and olympiad gold medals.
en.reason: OpenAI, Anthropic and Google have stopped promoting coding as their core selling point, shifting instead to math proofs, biological research and Olympiad gold medals, while most ordinary people still have not formed the habit of using AI for daily work.

Instead, they're all competing over hardcore scenarios like mathematical proofs, biological research, and olympiad gold medals.

sources.summary:
模力工场全新栏目开启！
模力工场全新栏目开启！
本文字数：2852 字
阅读完需：约 9 分钟
AI 企业落地面临需求诊断、ROI 评估与交付保障断层，模力工场以“供需大脑”角色连接行业场景与严选 FDE/产品团队。其落地路径始于线下技术活动，现推出「AI 圈有局」栏目聚合区域 AI 实践活动。
需诊断业务适配性的 AI 决策者；缺乏交付能力但具备场景的中型企业；寻求真实需求与合作机会的 FDE 及 AI 产品团队。
适合CTO、AI 项目负责人、AI 解决方案架构师、独立开发者及 AI 初创创始人阅读。
AI 正在从「个人尝鲜」，走向「企业落地」。
过去两年，越来越多的人借助 AI 做出了产品 Demo：一个人就能开发应用、搭建网站，承担过去一个小团队的工作量。但当 AI 真正走进企业，问题才刚刚开始：业务场景如何诊断？项目值不值得做、ROI 怎么算？方案有了，又去哪里找到靠谱的团队，把它交付成真正的业务结果？
一边是企业真实的 AI 落地需求，一边是快速成长的开发者、独立创业者和 AI 产品团队 —— 两端之间，始终缺一个把需求理解、能力匹配和交付保障串起来的角色。
这正是模力工场
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 模力工场「AI 圈有局」第01期汇总杭州、苏州5场AI活动，涵盖KCD杭州2026的Agent工程化论坛、总奖金5万元的科沃斯「八界杯」机器人挑战赛等。

sources.summary: Agent 能不能自己积累经验、改进技能，还越用越省钱？本期精选的10篇AI 论文从让 AI 记住每次修改的得失、自动盯训练，到精简 Skill、审核高风险更新，集中探讨了“如何让智能体持续进步”。做 Agent 开发或关注 AI 研究的朋友，可以重点看看其中的实践思路。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Google Cloud AI、Google DeepMind 和宾夕法尼亚州立大学提出带记忆的 SIM 优化器，记录改动理由与实测结果，解决框架从 Opus 迁到 Gemini 后起始得分 68.41 低于初始 73.89 的退化，十次编程实验九次提升，平均增 2.36 分（p=0.003）。

en.title: Nov 16–22 | This Week’s Top AI Papers
en.summary: Can agents accumulate experience on their own, improve their skills, and get cheaper to run the more they're used? This edition's 10 selected AI papers—spanning everything from letting AI remember the gains and losses of each edit and automatically monitoring training, to streamlining Skills and reviewing high-risk updates—focus on "how to make agents keep improving." Anyone building Agents or following AI research should take a close look at the practical ideas inside.
en.reason: Google DeepMind, Google Cloud AI and Penn State's SIM optimizer uses memory to fix a 68.41-vs-73.89 drop after Opus-to-Gemini migration and improve 9 of 10 coding experiments by 2.36 points (p=0.003), one of 10 papers on agents learning from experience.

stories.title: 成立仅一个月、核心班底只有两个人的独立研究实验室 Generalised Superintelligence（GSI），最近因宣布在量子计算、超导物理、芯片设计和纯数学等八大领域取得 250 多项突破而刷屏。 重点是GSI不是模型公司，他们只不过做了个harness。 与主流大模型实验室依赖海量显卡“暴力穷举”不同，GSI 面对指数级爆炸的复杂科学难题，他们不让 AI 盲目试错，而是先让模型识别问题背后的代数与几何对称性，在五六分钟内…

en.title: Generalised Superintelligence (GSI), an independent research lab founded just a month ago with a core team of only two people, has gone viral after announcing more than 250 breakthroughs across eight fields, including quantum computing, superconductivity, chip design, and pure mathematics.
en.reason: Two-person lab Generalised Superintelligence, one month old, claims 250-plus breakthroughs across eight fields—quantum computing, superconducting physics, chip design, pure math—via a harness compiling custom solvers in five to six minutes, hundreds to 30,000 times faster than general solvers.

en.title: Generalised Superintelligence (GSI), an independent research lab founded just a month ago with a core team of only two people, has gone viral after announcing more than 250 breakthroughs across eight fields, including quantum computing, superconductivity, chip design, and pure mathematics.

en.title: Confusion and Wisdom

在 App 里接入 AI 助手，最常见的做法还是聊天框：用户问一句，模型回一大段文字。可一旦涉及数据和操作，这种交互就很别扭。比如问「我这个月哪类支出最多」，答案埋在一段话里的第三行；想把订单里某个币的数量改一下，还得再打一句「把 SOL 改成 22 个」，然后等模型慢慢回。
Flutter 团队这次给出的解法是生成式 UI （ Generative UI ，下文简称 GenUI ）：智能体不回文字，而是直接回一个真实的 Flutter 界面，能点、能改、能滑。
11 月 17 号 A2UI 1.0 正式发布，原来的 genui 包也改名成了 a2ui_flutter 。这篇从上手讲起，再把五个新能力逐个拆开，其中「层级护栏」会用一个单测把两层校验跑一遍。看完你能知道：
官方博客里有个观点我很认同： GenUI 不是用来替换你的常规页面的。

en.title: The mainstream approach to AI knowledge bases is RAG — so how do you build RAG?
en.summary:
How do you typically build an AI knowledge base? The mainstream approach is RAG: chunk documents, build vector and keyword indexes, and store them; when a question comes in, retrieve relevant snippets first, then send them to an LLM to answer, with sources included. The model itself does not “remember” your data, and that content is not written into model parameters. Retrieval quality largely determines answer quality: if the retrieved snippets are wrong, even a fluent answer afterward is still wrong.

One pipeline is enough:

Data ingestion: documents, Wiki, tickets, code, and web pages. Only include content that is still maintained and has an owner.

Cleaning and chunking: remove headers and footers and duplicate paragraphs; split by headings and paragraphs. Start with chunk sizes of 300–800 characters, breaking at heading and paragraph boundaries; overlap adjacent chunks by about 10%–20% to avoid
en.reason: RAG knowledge bases chunk documents into 300–800 characters with 10%–20% overlap, index them by vector and keyword for retrieval, then have the model answer with sources cited, starting with 50–200 core documents on an existing platform.

en.reason: Graham Dumpleton, who started mod_wsgi 20 years ago, built Muru, an AI-assisted Rust server for ASGI and WSGI Python apps, with three weeks of detailed public logs on what still falls short.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章披露 Ghostscript Type 1 字体加载器的 use-after-free（CVE-2026-125396）可绕过 -dSAFER，并在 Google 文档渲染、WordPress 上传、Debian 13 的 IPP 队列和 Roundcube 缩略图路径中确认执行命令，上游修复对应 Artifex Bug 709684。

en.reason: A use-after-free in Ghostscript’s Type 1 font loader (CVE-2026-125396) bypasses -dSAFER to execute attacker-chosen commands, with confirmed command execution in Google Docs rendering, WordPress uploads, Debian 13 IPP queues and Roundcube thumbnails, fixed by Artifex Bug 709684.
